mapper.select: SELECT ps.id AS session_id, ps.user_id, ps.song_id, ps.bpm, ps.bpm_unit, ps.start_note_idx, ps.end_note_idx, ps.status, e.id AS evaluation_id, ps.fail_reason, (ps.recording_url IS NOT NULL AND ps.record_deleted_at IS NULL) AS recording_available, ps.started_at, ps.ended_at, ps.analysis_started_at, ps.saved_at, ps.memo FROM practice_sessions ps LEFT JOIN evaluations e ON e.session_id = ps.id WHERE ps.id = #{sessionId} AND ps.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE practice_sessions SET recording_url = #{recordingUrl}, recording_bytes = #{bytes}, recording_duration_ms = #{durationMs}, recording_sample_rate = #{sampleRate}, recording_channels = #{channels}, ended_at = #{uploadedAt}, status = 'PENDING', analysis_attempt = analysis_attempt + 1, analysis_started_at = #{uploadedAt} WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'RECORDING'
